title: Quantum Analysis of LESCA
problem: Stream cipher security under quantum attacks unclear; quantum implementation cost of LESCA unknown
motivation: NIST quantum security levels require formal assessment; need to understand LESCA resilience to quantum threats
method: Implement LESCA in quantum paradigm; analyze Grover's search algorithm cost on LESCA; verify NIST security levels
key_novelty: First quantum implementation and analysis of LESCA stream cipher
